claim: On October 9, 2025 the Amazon Quick documentation history recorded that Amazon QuickSight has been rebranded to Amazon Quick, and that QuickSight continues as Amazon Quick Sight, a core component within the Quick ecosystem.
question: What is the current name of Amazon QuickSight and since when?

qualifiers.scope: service name of Amazon QuickSight / Amazon Quick Sight
qualifiers.condition: All existing QuickSight APIs, SDKs, and integrations continue to work without changes.

note: d022. Use 'Amazon Quick (its BI part is Amazon Quick Sight, formerly Amazon QuickSight)' once in prose.
